more_info.overview: Ammonium phosphatides are mixtures of ammonium compounds of phosphatidic acids derived from edible fats and oils. Its emulsifying role is to help form or maintain mixtures of oil and water in the finished food. The specified material is supplied as solid. The specification describes it as effectively insoluble in water.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain cocoa and Chocolate products as covered by Directive 2000/36/EC; other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food-use estimates were below the limit.
Animal chronic and developmental studies found no effects at the tested high doses used in the assessment.
